v4.6.123 — Portfolio overview, suggested stocks & multi-model AI

📁 The manual tab is now a clean PORTFOLIO overview (no order entry). Click any holding to see that position's growth — % from your cost basis — with markers on the curve showing where you bought, bought more, sold some, or sold.

★ Find Stocks now has THIS WEEK'S SUGGESTED STOCKS. Tap one to research it; the AI evaluation is only generated when a stock is actually opened and is kept for the whole week.

🤖 Evaluations run on the APEX server and are the SAME for everyone — every AI model with a key (Claude, Gemini, Grok, Llama) gives its own review with a rating, confidence and bullish/bearish points, plus a consensus.

📈 Denser 1D/1W charts that fill the panel (tight, centered price axis), plus a fixed intraday timezone bug. Cleaner styling throughout.

Update via the in-app banner.
